summary: WP-002 code review passed. .refine(v => v === PLAN_ARCHIVE_FILENAME, {...}) added at line 241 of project-lifecycle.ts. Template literal interpolation in both the error message and describe string means auto-update if the constant ever changes. IdioMattic Zod approach: constraint fires at parse time, before any async handler logic. InitializeProjectSchema exported (only exported schema in the file) is the minimal change needed to allow test-side safeParse access. Negative test (design.md rejected) and positive test (plan.md accepted) both in place. All 6 AC met.

comments.note: The .refine() error message and .describe() string both use template literals to interpolate PLAN_ARCHIVE_FILENAME rather than hardcoding 'plan.md'. This means if the constant ever changes, both strings auto-update — correct defensive implementation.

InitializeProjectSchema is now the only exported schema in project-lifecycle.ts — all four sibling schemas (DetectProjectSchema, GetProjectStatusSchema, ListProjectsSchema, CompleteSynthesisSchema) remain unexported. The asymmetry is a pragmatic minimal-change decision to avoid test duplication. Non-blocking, but a future follow-up could standardize the pattern: either export all schemas or introduce a thin exported validator function to keep schemas private.
